dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible smooth, gradual 2D narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle, which is obscured by water at the terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters are visible along the lateral margins and posterior spine.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between primary light grey and secondary darker pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct, fine white linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the mid-dorsal and right lateral surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of fine white linear rake marks on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, dark longitudinal line marks the posterior dorsal ridge.
